landing_pages.overview:
How we plan: three steps from first audit to patient walk-ins. We audit what you run today, launch channels by locality, then keep refining against walk-ins, not clicks or leads. First you tell us about your clinic — your centres, treatments, targets and the problems you are facing. Then we map the gaps, reviewing your ads, Maps listings, calls and CRM to find where patients drop off. Finally you get a proven plan, scoped to start within 5 km of each centre, with monthly walk-in reviews built in.

No office visit needed — we come to your clinic or hospital. On the first visit we meet your team, review enquiry handling and note how patients currently find you, then return on an agreed schedule to review walk-ins and front-desk handling. Every website form and WhatsApp enquiry is saved in one record with its source, a dashboard shows leads, appointments and walk-ins by channel, and we keep your CRM if it captures source and outcome or move you to MedLift. We cover Thiruvananthapuram city and suburbs, including Thampanoor, East Fort, Peroorkada, Vellayambalam, Kesavadasapuram, Kazhakoottam, Technopark and Neyyattinkara. To plan an onboarding visit, call our team on +91 7428094567.

faqs.q: How do you choose the best digital marketing company in Thiruvananthapuram?
faqs.a: Do thorough research first. Weigh client testimonials about the company, its portfolio, healthcare expertise and a track record you can verify. Ask how it reports results and whether walk-ins are tracked. Every ad it runs should show the doctor's registration details, as NMC rules require.

faqs.q: Should a Thiruvananthapuram hospital advertise in Tamil?
faqs.a: It can help if a meaningful share of patients come from Kanyakumari district or nearby Tamil Nadu towns. Run Tamil ads alongside Malayalam and English versions, then compare walk-ins by language. NMC rules, including doctor registration details, apply in every language.

faqs.q: How can private clinics in Thiruvananthapuram compete with large hospitals online?
faqs.a: By being specific. Large hospitals cover many departments, while a focused clinic can show clear treatment pages, accurate Maps details, visible specialist qualifications and quick replies to enquiries. Those factual signals help patients compare, and they stay within NMC rules.

faqs.q: How does missed-call recovery work for a Thiruvananthapuram clinic?
faqs.a: When a call goes unanswered, the system sends an automatic WhatsApp reply, so the patient is not left waiting. The enquiry is saved in one record with its source. This approach typically recovers 20–30% of missed leads within the same session.

faqs.q: Can clinics in Thiruvananthapuram use patient reviews in ads?
faqs.a: No. Under the NMC guidelines of 6 October 2026, patient testimonials, reviews, ratings and success stories cannot appear in ads, landing pages or promotional posts. Clinics can still share factual facility details, doctor qualifications and health awareness content that does not solicit patients.
